question: If J is coded as N, R is coded as V and X is coded as B, then how will you code JOY?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df855d514a77ea4a7d76ff36c84d8a5bbadd4cedca4fe8579c4570f78aa68297.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• J is coded as N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0c4c6fb9c706699f76c7106c1dfe16a4e6227ffe42deb13b7c776b81cf1ce07.png] 

 
• R is coded as V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37e9d5182a14a27b81bd5d40b6dbffcb21be80390bdc31fc35c7ca89507a996f.png] 

 
• X is coded as B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3b1ae66013571833123baf9c65bd260079944860cf42dc271bf857da2adcf60.png] 

Similarly, JOY is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc61395d38c4fdcf20005914b577f881f9efcb77579f4a3cbfc09ea76064f5d6.png] 

Hence. the correct answer is **"NSC".**
